emergency.title: Not for emergencies
emergency.body: Messages here are not for emergencies. If you need help right away, press and hold the SOS button or call your barangay health worker.

join.title: Video consultation
join.early: You can join from {{time}}, 10 minutes before the call.
join.open: The call room is open. You can join now.

threads.title: Conversations
threads.emptyBarangay: Say hello to your barangay health workers.
threads.lockedNoAppointment: Opens when your teleconsultation is approved.
threads.lockedFollowUpOver: The follow-up chat closed. Request a new consultation to message the midwife again.

bookings.title: Booking requests
bookings.emptyBody: Ask for a clinic visit or a teleconsultation. The Municipal Health Office will confirm the time.
bookings.waiting: Waiting to send. It goes out when your connection is back.

book.title: Request a consultation
book.intro: Choose the kind of visit, the day and time you prefer and tell us why. A midwife will confirm the final time.
book.typeClinic: Clinic visit at the barangay health station
book.sent: Request sent. We will tell you when it is approved.
book.queued: Saved. It will be sent when your connection is back.
book.pendingBanner: You already have a request waiting. You can ask again once it has an answer.

chat.empty: No messages yet. Write the first one below.
chat.lockedNoAppointment: You can message the midwife once a teleconsultation is approved. Request one from the Consult tab.
chat.lockedFollowUpOver: The follow-up chat stays open for 24 hours after the appointment, and that time has passed. Request a new consultation to message the midwife again.
chat.joinHint: The call room opens 10 minutes before the appointment.

composer.label: Message
composer.waiting: Messages written offline wait on your phone and go out when the connection is back.

error.empty: Write a message or add a photo first.
error.tooLong: That message is too long. Please shorten it.
error.not_found: We could not find this conversation.
error.not_allowed: You cannot do that with this account.
error.photo: That photo could not be used.
error.past: Please choose today or a later date.
error.tooFar: Please choose a date within the next 3 months.
error.pending_exists: You already have a request waiting.
error.type: Please choose a photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP).
error.size: That photo is too large. Please choose a smaller one.
error.unreadable: That photo could not be read. Please choose another.

call.waitingHint: Stay on this screen. The call starts when your midwife joins.
